decision: Rejected; production sources and artifacts retain the baseline. Small prefill gains do not justify the consistent decode regression.
experiment: Compact recurrence intermediate to FP32 state plus y; multicast prepared auxiliary data to finish, double-buffer consumers and auxiliary input/final output, retain single-buffer prepared producer. Arithmetic unchanged.
capacity_evidence: Original intermediate plus double-buffer prepared consumers fails local SRAM placement for a 6912-byte buffer.
Compact intermediate with double-buffer producer exceeds program memory by 112 bytes.
Single-buffer prepared producer with double-buffer consumers compiles for both recurrence variants.
traffic_note: This changes internal buffering and stream layout, not host DDR payload. Prepared auxiliary data is multicast; no bandwidth or compute utilization claim follows from host timing.

whole_model_protocol.order: A/B/B/A for each precision, serial NPU dispatch

correctness.stage: Both variants passed numerical oracle, deterministic replay and guards. Fused max_abs 9.53674e-7; regular max_abs 1.19209e-6.
correctness.model: BF16 and INT8 FFN+output each passed 128-token regression, 1116 exact vectors, zero differences.
correctness.limitation: Candidate rejected before additional 1533-vector prefill equivalence validation.

next: Reduce cross-program submissions or batch further work; isolated recurrence speed is not a reliable predictor of resident decode speed. Hardware limits for the whole model remain unproven.
